name: Enomiya Yui
source:
She is a beautiful, mature girl with long black hair. She is a member of the student council and has excellent grades.

 She has a strong desire to serve others and takes the lead because she wants to make them feel good. She is also known as the "Bitch who manufactures spoiled men."

She is popular among the opposite sex for the gap between her devotion and motherly nature, her innocent appearance, and her man-loving body.

Outside of the Bitch Club, she helps out at her family's hospital and does volunteer work.

[From [url=http://www.ordin-soft.com/bitchclub_s.html#character]official site[/url]]
